## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Associated Entities

## Anti-Money Laundering / Combating Terrorist Financing

## FATF Statement on Iran

The Financial Action Task Force ('FATF') issued a public statement on 11 October 2007 expressing its concern about Iran's lack of comprehensive anti-money laundering/ combating the financing of terrorism ('AML/CFT') regime.   FATF called upon Iran to address on an urgent basis its  AML/CFT deficiencies including those identified in the 2006 International Monetary Fund Article IV Consultation Report for Iran.  The statement can be found on the website of FATF http://www.fatf-gafi.org).

Licensed  corporations  and  associated  entities  are  advised  to  take  the  risk  arising  from  the deficiencies in Iran's AML/CFT regime into account for enhanced due diligence.

Should  you  have  any  queries  regarding  the  contents  of  this  circular,  please  contact  Ms Kammy Kwok at 2840-9455.
